pipelineStages.name: Input Parser & Normalizer
pipelineStages.summary: Parsed 70 VHIS certified families (observed 262 CSV rows) & 64 company product records across 12 insurers.

pipelineStages.name: Strict Matcher & Quality Reviewer
pipelineStages.summary: Strictly matched 112/312 existing app plans (zero false-positive guesses) and flagged 56 CSV anomalies + 13 missing VHIS columns.

pipelineStages.name: Auto-Improver & Catalog Enricher
pipelineStages.summary: Blocked suspect non-brochure PDFs, stripped anti-phishing boilerplate, resolved '產品概覽' / mis-scraped headers, wired vhis.gov.hk Policy Doc & Standard Premium PDFs, and imported 14 verified new active plans.

pipelineStages.name: Final Integrity Checker
pipelineStages.summary: 100% HTTPS URL compliance verified across 112 patched plans + 14 newly imported plans (0 dead/suspect links).
